description:
The Establishment of Broiler Farms scheme was launched by the Government of India in 2018. 

This initiative is part of the broader effort to enhance the poultry sector in India. 

The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among rural youth. 

It also seeks to increase the production of poultry meat in the country. 

The Indian poultry industry has seen significant growth over the past few decades. 

As of 2021, India was the third-largest producer of broiler meat in the world. 

The government recognized the potential for job creation and income generation in this sector. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to establish broiler farms across various states. 

The government aims to set up at least 20,000 broiler farms by 2025. 

Each farm is expected to have a capacity of around 1,000 to 5,000 birds. 

The scheme targets rural youth and unemployed individuals. 

It encourages them to take up poultry farming as a viable source of income. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial. 

Eligible applicants can receive up to INR 1 lakh as a subsidy. 

This subsidy covers 25% of the total project cost for general category applicants. 

For Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes applicants, the subsidy can go up to 33%. 

The scheme also includes provisions for training and skill development. 

The government partners with various agricultural universities and institutions. 

These institutions provide training on modern poultry farming techniques. 

The training programs cover aspects such as biosecurity, feeding, and disease management. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

Interested individuals must approach the nearest Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying office. 

They need to fill out an application form available at the office or online. 

The required documents include proof of identity, address, and age. 

Applicants must also submit a project report detailing the proposed farm. 

This report should include the estimated costs and expected returns. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by a committee. 

The committee assesses the viability of the proposed project. 

If approved, the subsidy amount is disbursed directly to the applicant's bank account. 

The timeline for application processing typically ranges from 30 to 60 days. 

The disbursement of funds is usually done in a single installment. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

This department operates under the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

Contact details for the department can be found on their official website. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of sustainable farming practices. 

Farmers are encouraged to adopt eco-friendly methods. 

This includes using organic feed and maintaining proper waste management. 

The government provides additional support for marketing the poultry products. 

This support includes connecting farmers with local markets and buyers. 

The scheme has the potential to create thousands of jobs in rural areas. 

It also aims to improve the nutritional standards of the population. 

Poultry meat is a significant source of protein for many households. 

The government has set a target to increase per capita availability of poultry meat. 

As of 2021, the per capita availability was around 5 kg per year. 

The aim is to raise this figure to 10 kg per year by 2025. 

The scheme also aligns with the National Livestock Mission. 

This mission focuses on enhancing livestock production in a sustainable manner. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 2,000 crore for the National Livestock Mission. 

Part of this budget is earmarked for the establishment of broiler farms. 

The scheme also encourages women to participate in poultry farming. 

Women entrepreneurs can avail of the same subsidy benefits. 

This is part of the government's effort to empower women in rural areas. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many have reported increased income and improved living standards. 

The government regularly monitors the progress of the scheme. 

This includes tracking the number of farms established and the production levels. 

The scheme is expected to contribute significantly to the rural economy. 

It also aims to reduce the dependence on imported poultry products. 

The establishment of broiler farms can lead to self-sufficiency in poultry production. 

The government is also exploring partnerships with private sector players. 

These partnerships can enhance the supply chain and distribution networks. 

The scheme has the potential to transform the poultry sector in India. 

It encourages innovation and the adoption of new technologies. 

Farmers are also encouraged to use digital platforms for marketing. 

This can help them reach a wider customer base. 

The government provides resources and guidance for digital marketing. 

The scheme is a step towards achieving food security in the country. 

It aims to make poultry farming a sustainable and profitable venture. 

The establishment of broiler farms is crucial for rural development. 

It provides a source of income and employment for many families. 

The government continues to promote the scheme through various outreach programs. 

These programs aim to raise awareness about the benefits of poultry farming. 

The scheme is a vital part of India's agricultural policy framework. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the livelihoods of rural communities. 

The establishment of broiler farms is an important initiative for economic growth. 

It has the potential to uplift entire communities through sustainable practices. 

The scheme is a significant move towards enhancing food production in India. 

It aligns with the global goals of promoting sustainable agriculture. 

The government remains focused on the successful implementation of this scheme. 

This includes regular evaluations and adjustments based on feedback from beneficiaries. 

The establishment of broiler farms is a promising opportunity for aspiring farmers. 

It opens doors to a thriving industry with immense potential for growth. 

The government encourages all eligible individuals to take advantage of this scheme. 

This initiative is a beacon of hope for rural development and self-sufficiency.
